title: Hungry Creatures
overview: When Tess starts working in her aunt and uncle's restaurant, she encounters mysterious monsters and visions that send her down a dark, twisty path of moral reckoning.

title: Frozen III
overview: Third installment in the Disney animated franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Elegy to a Missing Friend
overview: In the aftermath of her friend's passing, an artist processes her grief by making a film. She weaves her personal archival footage and an unfinished science-fiction narrative into a deeply raw and emotive work of art.

title: The Bluey Movie
overview: On an action-packed day, a big surprise changes everything for Bluey and her family.

title: Paranormal Activity 8
overview: The eighth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Logan
overview: In development.

title: 'Tis the Season
overview: Two wealthy children hold a washed-up mall Santa hostage as their Christmas Eve spirals into chaos.

title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
original_title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
overview: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

title: Elsinore
overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

title: MEN TOO
overview: A man struggles to stay strong after a painful divorce, moving through his days with a quiet loneliness that no one notices. This PSA explores how a single moment of genuine care can change everything for someone who feels forgotten.

title: Harvested 4
overview: A small town legend returns from the dead to serve vengeance on Thanksgiving night.

title: Malvina
overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport: Everest's north face.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Deathbed
overview: A young woman encounters a ghost, and her fixation on the experience begins to unravel her toxic friend group.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

title: Better Future
overview: After four years as an immigrant in the United States, Julio, who works as part of the cleaning staff at a hospital, struggles to stay sober. Separated from his daughter and with his marriage in crisis, he searches for a fresh start amid the hardships of his daily life.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: Robbin' the Hood
overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

title: Nobody's Perfect
overview: The Black Country, 1995 - Two sisters confront each other about sorting their late father's estate, whilst on a cigarette break as children's party entertainers.

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: The Path
overview: A film the follows Holly Beckham (Ngāpuhi) is on a mission to be the first Māori woman to scale Everest. She has no alpine experience, but she has survived the depths of addiction and is climbing a mountain to recovery.

title: Cuppa' Joe
overview: Beneath the canned laughter of a 1950s sitcom, an Asian-Native Hawaiian couple navigates a dystopian allegory of diaspora, identity, and the cost of belonging in America.

title: The Vanishing Song
overview: Cut off from his kind, a lone gibbon calls out from a vanishing forest patch in the heart of a Malaysian city — and a team races to reach him before time runs out.

title: Magick Mtn.
overview: Lord Mmorke, a tepid and ghoulish narrator, walks us through 3 separate fables all intersecting in a realm beyond the tangible. Rituals and retellings about a Deathrock squatter jailed by a sadistic psychiatrist and the evils of regret, a pair of criminal plumbers plunging further towards Hell's grips and the beer-soaked leather of the Sunset Strip, and an architect's ambition built on the shaky bedrock of the Devil's promise. What begins as a tale ends in a spell cast upon unsuspecting characters and audiences alike

title: Love and Katsom
overview: A Vanuatu-New Zealand documentary following real-life couple Kersom and Benina as they navigate modern romance and traditional kastom around their wedding.

title: Descendants of Niue
overview: Stories of Niue follows the journey of preservation and celebration of Niuean culture, language, and heritage, highlighting the voices and stories of the island's local community navigating life in Niue and the diaspora.

title: Jollyface
overview: The  movie follows a woman investigating a murder while being hunted in her apartment building.

title: Concerto Muerto
overview: A pianist learns what it's like to really be INSIDE his piano...

title: In Her You'll Find Sanctuary
overview: After the arrival of a nun with mystical visions, Sister Miriam becomes envious of her rival's sudden notoriety and begins falsifying miracles in a grotesque game of spiritual cat-and-mouse.

title: Drop Dead
overview: A group of strangers board a freight elevator and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.

title: The Hummingbird Paints Fragrant Songs
overview: Indigenous Peruvian Amazon artist Sara Flores gains international recognition in her 70s, navigating between defending her community from illegal logging and the luxury art world.

title: Almost Afraid
overview: Simon Britton, documentarian and skeptic, visits Brisbane's most haunted house to investigate reports of paranormal activity.

title: DEAD AIR
overview: It's 3 AM and AM radio host Skip Kabasinsky has a strange night ahead of him.

title: Malevolent
overview: A construction worker, arrives at a house he is assigned to demolish, only to have the place reopen the shadows of his past.

title: Vintage Violence
overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: While the City Sleeps
overview: A journey inside Victoria BC's thriving graffiti subculture, full of rich history and conflicts with the municipal government. Featuring interviews with 17 of the city's most notorious graffiti artists, this documentary paints a picture of Victoria's graffiti scene in it's entirety.

title: Anna
overview: Anna convinces her ex girlfriend Mia to see her by lying that her grandmother has just passed away. But when Mia arrives, Anna soon realises her lie might have deeper consequences than she expected…

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: For a Future That May or May Never Be
original_title: For a Future That May or May Never Be
overview: In a country where the future feels perpetually uncertain, a new generation of Lebanese artists are forcing their own path. The film moves across interviews and archival footage, asking what it means to keep creating throughout uncertainty and upheaval.

title: Cosmic Symphony
overview: Four iconic instruments, including The Wizard of Oz and A Star Is Born pianos, all lost in the 2025 Los Angeles Fires, are celebrated by their musicians, culminating in an animated send-off towards an imagined future, a Cosmic Symphony. Directed by Oscar-nominated composer Laura Karpman, and featuring John Clayton, Susie Chung, Starr Parodi and Diane Warren, Cosmic Symphony explores a truth that every musician knows - musical instruments have souls.

title: Barood
overview: Barood is a story of today's youngsters being exploited by corruption. Jui, an innocent girl, falls in love with a loafer Shaon. And this turns Shaon's life upside down. The lovebirds wish to live a fairytale life but the circumstances are against them. In the race between love and society - who wins?

title: Intergalactic Crusade III
overview: A Jelf terrorist is on the loose, and its up to Steevusandbeebus and Moony Jam to end him once and for all. That is until a shock civilian death sends the two spiralling into momentous disagreement. Contains discoveries that may, or may not be, multiversal.

title: The Perfect Dih
overview: When middle-aged suburban dad Ben Kr€uz€d€r gets accidentally booked on a luxury Miami yacht cruise meant exclusively for hyper-bronzed looksmaxxers, he must team up with an unnaturally jacked, open-shirted influencer who looks like he feeds on pure creatine and jawline exercises. Together, they must cook the most legendary, high-stakes 5-course dinner in South Florida history to save a failing floating restaurant, despite Ben only knowing how to microwave pizza rolls.

title: Kristal krvi
overview: Legend has it that a mysterious crystal grants its owner immense wealth. Determined to find it, two grave robbers embark on a perilous quest, unaware of the creatures, curses and ancient evil guarding it.

title: Daughters of 9/11
overview: Twenty-five years after the deadliest terrorist attack on American soil, Elizabeth Miller, Jessica Trant and FBI special agent Frank Pellegrino confront whether the man accused of masterminding the attacks, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed (KSM), will ever face justice.

title: Tribeca 25
overview: 25 years after 9/11, discover how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

title: Beating
overview: Set in a slaughterhouse in Ferry, Kiro, a 10-year-old student, is cast as a leaf in a school play for his science project. As he begins to understand more about his role, he realizes that he no longer wants to play it.

title: The Cat Is A Wide-Eyed Night
original_title: The Cat Is A Wide-Eyed Night
overview: Two brothers' sporadic visits to their death-ridden mother becomes the long-lost road to their unending love for each other.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: Tickets, Please.
overview: On her daily commute to work, an aspiring entrepreneur has recurring visions of a man finding a duffel bag full of cash. But when she encounters strange people who suddenly become rich in unexpected ways, her reality begins to unravel as she struggles with the unseen powers which determine fate and fortune.

title: When America Took the Field
overview: How baseball helped restore normalcy and unite the country after the September 11 attacks.

title: Swarm
overview: Swarm, 2026, McCall’s most recent work, premiering in the exhibition, draws on the rising significance of drones as an increasing presence in daily life. The installation is composed of two conical-light volumes that rotate slowly in opposite directions, one clockwise and the other counterclockwise, over a duration of fifteen minutes. Accompanying the mesmerizing visuals is a rich soundscape that gradually intensifies as a powerful auditory experience. The dramatic, progressive soundtrack serves as a continuation of the ongoing collaboration between McCall and Grubbs.

title: The Next Shift
overview: In efforts to try and fit in with his new classmates, Wesley decides to join a couple of them on a night out that leads to a crime that may change the course of his life.

title: Gracie Abrams - Amazon Music Songline
overview: A docu-performance film featuring reimagined songs and exclusive performances from Abrams' third album "Daughter from Hell", recorded at the historic Church Studios in North London.

title: On The Cutting Room Floor
overview: When two filmmakers, Lana and Keith, become entangled in each other's lives, personally and professionally, it becomes apparent that their relationship is less stable than it seemed.

title: IDOL
overview: An ambitious teenage wrestler, who obsesses over an Olympic champion, sacrifices and destroys himself through the berating of his father in order to have a chance at being like his idol.

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: LOUTROPOLIS
overview: When the urban regeneration project of the former Ellinikon International Airport of Athens begins right outside his door, Vasos, one of the area’s oldest residents, struggles to adjust to a place that no longer feels like home.

title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
overview: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

title: Little Short Films: An Anthology
overview: MOVING DAY, BEAM ME UP THIS PLACE SUCKS, CABIN FEVER, BETWEEN THE PAGES

title: The Ira Curry Story: The Making of the King of Business
original_title: The Ira Curry Story: The Making of the King of Business
overview: Rejection rocked Curry’s rise to the throne as years of sacrifice and relentless building tested a vision the world could not yet see. This is the story of how Ira Curry built the Business Celebrity Movement with almost nothing.

title: Faux Amis
overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: THE UNKNOWN GUN MAN
overview: While meditating on his terrace, Shubh discovers a mysterious gun wrapped with a chilling message: “Please hide this. He is coming.” Confused and frightened, he hides the weapon, unaware that someone is already looking for it. As Shubh tries to make sense of what has happened, a mysterious stranger finally arrives, turning an ordinary evening into a terrifying encounter.

title: Love, Rendered
overview: Follows an octogenarian couple: Burt is losing his memory; his loving wife Ethelle wants him to retain their most meaningful memories together.

title: I Hope This Finds You Well
original_title: I Hope This Finds You Well
overview: A Hollywood assistant tries to send an important email.

title: Sky Defenders
overview: As missiles and drones reshape modern warfare, the battle for control of the sky has never been more critical. Sky Defenders goes inside the world of NASAMS, one of the world’s most advanced air-defence systems. From its origins in Norway to military operations across Europe, Australia and Ukraine, the film reveals the technology, international partnerships and people behind a system built to protect the skies. With extraordinary access to soldiers, engineers, factories and live military exercises, Sky Defenders is ultimately a story about the people behind the technology and the race to protect millions from an evolving threat from above.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: LADY IN RED
overview: Vik, Sunny, and JT spend Vik’s bachelor weekend at the Palace Hotel, weeks before he is about to get married. Tensions heighten quickly when Vik won't put his phone down, causing multiple riffs in the friendship, leading to the biggest mistake Vik could make. Repeatedly, he finds himself at the hands of a timeless lady walking the halls of the hotel in a red dress. After an argument with JT, Vik’s final moments of sanity are taken by the Lady in Red, and he follows her to her room, where she traps him for good. JT and Sunny search for him after their own encounter with her as she haunts the halls in her true form. Their lives certainly change forever as the Lady in Red secures her spot as top of the food chain at the Palace Hotel.

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: The Blue Sea
overview: A fisherman has the impression that he is rotting from the inside, like one of his teeth that is bothering him. Lost in the maze of his painful memories, frustrated by the sense of disorder that surrounds him, he is helpless in the face of the spectacle of the repressed demonstrators he sees every day on television. His depression causes his body to melt in an abstract way and to disperse in trails of droplets, in the manner of Francis Bacon's portraits.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
original_title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

title: Deadly Fruit
overview: Deadly Fruit is a 2026 thriller movie directed by Shannon Washington that follows a divorced man named Malcolm who falls for a charming woman with a hidden, violent past.

title: Hammer and Nail
overview: Ondřej Blažek, confronts the raw, untold emotions behind the fight. This UFC-inspired documentary takes you deep into the mind of a fighter, where each punch carries the weight of personal sacrifice, triumph, and inner demons. With high-octane energy and cinematic intensity, Coach Ondřej revisits pivotal moments from his career, reflecting on the emotional turmoil and adrenaline that fuel him. Watch as we recreate one of his most defining fights, immersing you in the brutal reality of what it means to fight, not just against your opponent—but against yourself.

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: From Zema With Love
overview: Super-spy Love plays a game of seduction with the charming femme fatale Zema. Created for Zema Vinyl Lounge in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

title: Did You Twirl?
overview: An autistic dancer twirls and twirls as fast as he can to keep up with the ever-turning world around him.

title: Déluge mineur
overview: Joseph is looking for Mara. Mara is trying to find herself. He meets up with her at a party. People are talking about a white whale that has been washed up on the beach. Mara wants to see it, and Joseph wants to follow Mara – never mind the gathering storm.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Brandon & Haider
overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: Welcome to the Family
overview: Silas feels the pressure as he's one step closer to belonging to the Family.

title: Les 50 ans d'Aude
overview: Fifty years is a birthday milestone. Celebrating years of someone's life is the best way to show how much you love and cherish a person. This short film was created to honour Aude, the mother of one of the best friends of the couple who directed it.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Dead Reset
overview: Trapped in an underwater research facility, surgeon Cole Mason is forced to operate on a mutating, parasitic creature. The catch? He’s trapped in a brutal, blood-soaked time loop and must relive his own violent demise over and over again. To survive, Cole must embrace death and find a way to kill the creature and stop the loop before he becomes trapped in a never ending spiral of horror.

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
overview: Conjure the spirit of indie-rock icon Jason Molina (1973-2013) with Ohio insiders who illuminate Truth about his coming of age on Lake Erie, escaping artless steel town indifference, and manifesting the legendary band, Songs: Ohia, as they celebrate contradictions that tether Jason’s raunchy humor, propensity to lie, refusal to interpret lyrics, and untimely death into a haunting legacy unconfined by the record vault.

title: Ithaqua
overview: During the decline of the fur trade, a mercenary struggles to unite the survivors of a famine-stricken outpost plagued by a dark force that leaves its victims with an insatiable hunger.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.
